name: Grandmother Devi Tide
reason: No own website or contact route found: web searches show her as head (Kefayat) of the Sufi Healing Order and convener of the Rainbow Journeys, but the order's site sufihealingorder.org returned Cloudflare error 521 (origin down) on 5 Nov 2026, and the other pages found are old event listings and magazine articles (2016-2021). No published email or contact form of hers, and no photos or items could be confirmed from her own pages.
